item.title: Short Film Pathway readiness quiz
item.content:
Before you start Short Film Pathway: can you answer these? Your answers aren't recorded.

What makes a story work in a short film only a few minutes long?

One clear character with a goal, a simple conflict, a beginning, middle and end, an emotional change, and storytelling that relies on pictures more than words.

How can an animator convey a character's emotion without dialogue?

Through posing and silhouette, timing and spacing, facial expression, acting choices and staging.
